entities.name: Query Nnr protein
observations: 504 aa soluble enzyme-like protein; predicted molecular weight 53.9 kDa and theoretical pI 5.51.
Contains YjeF_N domain (PF03853) at residues 26–189 and Carb_kinase domain (PF01256) at residues 248–487.
Near-full-length homologs Q2RGI2, B1L3W1, and O67377 are reviewed bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes with 32.4–36.6% identity and 99.8% query coverage.
Most likely catalyzes NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of (S)-NAD(P)HX; exact substrate preference remains homology-based.
Likely binds one potassium ion per subunit by analogy to curated homologs.
Biological roles inferred from homologs include metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.

entities.name: Q2RGI2
observations: Reviewed Moorella thermoacetica Nnr homolog; 36.6% identity and 99.8% query coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated with EC 5.1.99.6 NAD(P)HX epimerase and EC 4.2.1.136 ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase.
Binds one potassium ion per subunit.
Annotated in metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.

entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair
observations: Repairs enzymatically or heat-generated NAD(P)HX damage by epimerizing R/S forms and dehydrating S-NAD(P)HX back to NAD(P)H or NADPH.
The dehydration reaction uses ADP and produces AMP plus phosphate.
